description: This file defines a mock class for the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server media player component. It includes mock methods for creating various player tasks related to media pipeline operations.

classes.name: GenericPlayerTaskFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface for testing purposes, providing mocked methods to simulate creation of media player tasks.

methods.name: createAttachSamples
methods.description: Mocks creation of a task to attach media samples to the player.

methods.description: Mocks creation of a task to attach a media source to the player.

methods.name: createDeepElementAdded
methods.description: Mocks creation of a task for handling deep element addition in the pipeline.

methods.name: createEnoughData
